name: Yuusha
source:
The hero of the new world. Nobody knows her real name. When she saw Animus and Lilim for sale at the market, she made quite a push to make sure they were hers. The two demons were encouraged upon learning their new owner was a hero, but there was a strange glint in her eye... 

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ385224.html/]DLsite[/url]]
